scientific_question: When every camera policy uses the same exact-adjoint H1 K0 reconstruction and the same logical 1A+1A^T online budget, does the v172 whole-field/time-isolated selector retain complete matched-accuracy value that cannot be explained by fit-static, v169 low-mode D-opt, or a result-free ray-diversity rule?
role: post-open equal-cost selector-only attribution on nine opened reconstructed fields, thirteen opened calibrations, and four opened times; not fresh external evidence, not resource evidence, and not real BOST
physical_hypothesis: The v172 selector captures calibration-dependent five-camera value beyond both fit-static outcome aggregation and deterministic geometry-only sensor-spread rules, even when reconstruction and exact-call cost are held fixed.

inputs.scope_boundary: all fields, calibrations, times, v172 selections, and prior candidate outcomes are already opened; v174 introduces no fresh data

selection_contract.v172_selector: policy index 0 from the sealed and independently reproduced v172 selection tensor
selection_contract.fit_static: policy index 1 from the same sealed v172 tensor
selection_contract.v169_low_mode_d_opt: policy index 2 from the same sealed v172 tensor; rank then low-mode log-pseudodeterminant, minimum positive eigenvalue, and trace

ray_axis_maximin.inputs: only the world-frame unit rays that enter the frozen forward operator
ray_axis_maximin.camera_axis: normalize the arithmetic mean of all 24x24 world-frame unit rays for each canonical camera
ray_axis_maximin.primary_score: maximize the minimum of the ten pair separations in each five-camera subset
ray_axis_maximin.tie_break: retain the lexicographically first subset in the sealed canonical roster

selection_contract.subset_mapping: indices address the sealed lexicographically sorted canonical five-of-nine roster
forbidden: field or observation error during selection
time as selector input for the deterministic maximin control
adding another geometry score after results

reconstruction_contract.candidate: same exact-adjoint DCT1023 H1 fixed-0.03 initializer at K0 for every policy
reconstruction_contract.reference: same selected subset with Zero-CGLS K4 for every policy
reconstruction_contract.h1_penalty: sum of squared physical DCT frequencies normalized by its positive median

exact_call_ledger.geometry_cache: DCT basis projections, subset Grams, generalized spectra, and ray-axis score construction are setup costs reported separately from logical online calls
exact_call_ledger.offline_truth_observation: one forward per unique scored subset and field-time cell is data construction only and cannot be counted as deployment speed evidence

matched_reference_gate.scope: each policy candidate is compared only with Zero-CGLS K4 on its own selected observation coordinates

independent_recomputation.operator: independent sparse row builder and bincount forward/adjoint
independent_recomputation.dct_basis: analytic tensor-product cosine basis rather than formal scipy idct basis
independent_recomputation.ray_axis_maximin: independent pair-distance matrix implementation; do not import the formal v174 selector
independent_recomputation.solver: independent CGLS recurrence; do not import the formal v174 runner or poolfire_c_baselines solver
required_checks: 468 cells per arm and 3744 total rows
primary candidate and reference physical fields and residuals
each policy absolute and own-reference matched gates
parent v173 primary H1-K0 and Zero-K4 reproduction

decision_order: Any input, parent, selection, operator, solve, call-accounting, numeric, seal, or independent-recomputation failure makes v174 inconclusive.
If the v172 selector with H1-K0 fails either the complete absolute gate or its same-subset Zero-K4 matched gate, conclude FAIL_SELECTOR_H1_K0_PARITY_V174.

If the v172 selector passes but any equal-cost fit-static, v169 low-mode D-opt, or ray-axis maximin control also passes its complete absolute and same-subset matched gates, conclude FAIL_EQUAL_COST_CONTROL_EXPLAINS_SELECTOR_V174 and close the current selector-value claim.
Only if the v172 selector passes, all three controls fail, all receipts are exact, and independent recomputation agrees may v174 conclude PASS_POSTOPEN_SELECTOR_ONLY_HEADROOM_V174.
A pass is only opened-development selector headroom. It is not external generalization, resource speedup, algorithm breakthrough, paper success, curved-ray validation, or real BOST.
